title: Response Scanner Upstream Dependency Closure
root_cause: Phase 2202 preserved response projection judgments but the source-AST pipeline still called the concrete scanResponseBundle function directly, leaving response acquisition outside its upstream dependency contract.
changes: Added LaravelResponseScannerInterface and its typed input/result contracts under types/upstream.
Added LaravelSourceAstPipelineDependenciesInterface to the existing upstream pipeline contract.
Added createLaravelSourceAstPipeline(dependencies), injecting response acquisition through the interface.
Bound the default composition root to the existing response scanner adapter while retaining the compatibility function.
Added structural tests for the upstream scanner contract, injection, and delegation.

validation.typescript_syntax_transpilation: 7/7 changed TypeScript files passed transpileModule syntax diagnostics

remaining_gaps: The concrete response scanner adapter remains in the legacy subscanners directory.
The response scanner implementation retains existing direct semantic/relations imports; this phase does not claim repository-wide relation dependency removal.
Other source-AST acquisition domains still use concrete scanner implementations and have not been closed under this dependency contract.
Full TypeScript typecheck, Vitest, and package build were not executed.
